knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A used solution can carry organisms between areas. The guideline asks for fresh solution at a frequent interval, as policy directs. The other reasons are not in the guideline.
The guideline allows two routes: wash and dry before the next use, or pick a disposable head. The remaining choices leave contamination behind.
The guideline lists colour coding as a tool to reduce cross-infection. Option B states that purpose; the other options describe things the colours do not do.

practicalCriteria: Learner sets up a bucket and cloths for one area using the site colour code, without mixing zones.
Learner cleans and dries a mop head, or replaces a single-use head, after a demonstration clean.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Colour code is not known for the zone
Equipment shows body substances that cannot be cleaned away or swapped out
